title: Magnolia Sunset Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Charcoal grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Golf cart friendly neighborhood - Community pool - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) -Pet Fee $150 Stay in the heart of 30A paradise! Located in the private neighborhood of Magnolia Cottages By The Sea near Seacrest, “Magnolia Sunset” is a charming 3 bedroom/3 bath home with all the amenities beach living has to offer. 5-minute walk to the private beach access & neighborhood pool, just 1 mile to The Hub & Alys and 2 miles to Rosemary! Magnolia Sunset sleeps 8 guests with a generous open floorplan. Upon entering the cottage, you will be welcomed into a well-stocked, updated and open kitchen. The kitchen bar seats 4 while the dining area, just off of the kitchen seats 8 comfortably. The kitchen opens up to the great room that features beautiful, planked ceilings, a large 50-inch television with enough seating for the whole family to enjoy. Start your day with your morning coffee or happy hour on the oversized screened in porch located right off of the living and dining room. The porch overlooks peaceful, private wooded views perfect for relaxing.
